tools.name: open_slates
tools.description: Lists the open DraftKings and FanDuel slates, the next lock first: slateId, site, sport, type, name, lock (US Eastern), games, and page (the slate's free web page). Filter by site or sport. Use a slateId with top_players.

tools.name: top_players
tools.description: The top 10 players of one open slate by projection, and the top 10 by value (projected points per $1,000 of salary; on the NFL, at most 2 of each position), with each player's salary and projection. `optimizer` is the free optimizer of this slate: the user builds up to 20 lineups there with his own
